summary: Frontend-only regression test of POS 'El monto es menor que la venta' bug. Executed 2 real cash sales through the UI at /app/pos with the admin account. Both sales confirmed successfully with prefilled exact amount, cambio=$0.00, ticket dialog shown, success toast rendered. Bug is FIXED from the user's perspective.
action_items: Clean up test-created sales folios V000004 and V000005 from DB (both are 'Público General' cash sales created during this iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: POS.jsx totals useMemo (lines 127-137) correctly matches the backend calcular_venta contract now: it extracts neto from price-with-IVA (base/(1+iva/100)) and computes total = neto - descGlobal + iva. This is consistent with backend fix, so POS total = ticket total = pagos prefilled = cambio 0.00. No further changes required.

openPay() prefills the exact total as monto (String(totals.total)), which is the reason cambio arrives at exactly 0.00 and the new 1-cent tolerance in the backend is basically not exercised via the default UI path. If manual editing of monto with more decimals is expected, the tolerance still guards it.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 real cash sales in DB: V000004 (1 unit, total $55.56) and V000005 (3 units, total $166.68). Client: Público General. Please delete after review.

Search input has data-testid=pos-search-input; typing 'a' returns products; results are rendered in the first .overflow-y-auto container inside [data-testid=pos-page] and each direct child is a clickable product row. rca of the issue: Original bug: backend calcular_venta was treating prices coming from the frontend as NET (subtotal += cantidad*precio) and then adding IVA on top (base*(1+iva/100)), while the frontend/priceOf sends precio_con_iva (IVA-inclusive). Result: backend total was ~16% higher than the UI total, so contado validation (pagado < total) failed even when the user paid the UI-shown total. Fix applied: (a) backend calcular_venta now extracts neto from price-with-IVA (neto = base/(1+iva/100), iva_total = base - neto), matching the ticket rendering and the UI totals; (b) create_sale contado validation uses `round(pagado,2) + 0.01 < round(total,2)` to tolerate cent rounding. UI verification confirms: total 55.56 and 166.68 both accepted with cambio $0.00, no 'monto menor' error.
